# jamfplatform_pro_network_segment (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro network segment by ID or by exact name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be supplied.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account. `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Organizational context | Network segments | Read | `network-segments` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jamfplatform_pro_network_segment" "example_by_id" {
  id = "3"
}

data "jamfplatform_pro_network_segment" "example_by_name" {
  name = "HQ Office"
}

output "network_segment_example_by_id" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_network_segment.example_by_id
}

output "network_segment_example_by_name" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_network_segment.example_by_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Network segment ID. Mutually exclusive with `name`.
- `name` (String) Network segment display name (exact match). Mutually exclusive with `id`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `building` (String) Building associated with the network segment.
- `department` (String) Department associated with the network segment.
- `distribution_point` (String) Distribution point assigned by Jamf Pro for this segment.
- `distribution_server` (String) Distribution server assigned by Jamf Pro for this segment.
- `ending_address` (String) Ending IP address of the network segment.
- `override_buildings` (Boolean) Whether devices joining this segment have their building overridden.
- `override_departments` (Boolean) Whether devices joining this segment have their department overridden.
- `starting_address` (String) Starting IP address of the network segment.
- `swu_server` (String) Software update server assigned by Jamf Pro for this segment.
- `url` (String) NetBoot/imaging URL assigned by Jamf Pro for this segment.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
